body.objective: What is the architecture of Factory.ai's Droids: execution environment, context and memory, how tasks are delegated, and how output is verified? What do engineering write-ups or benchmarks say about results? Rank first primary sources: Factory.ai's own engineering blog posts, official docs (docs.factory.ai), talks, and technical papers, followed by credible reporting and independent benchmark write-ups (e.g. Terminal-Bench, SWE-bench results). Pull out mechanisms (sandbox or local execution environment, Droid Exec, context and memory handling, codebase and organizational context, integrations, task delegation between Droids and subagents, human-in-the-loop controls, verification via tests, linting, and code review), plus names, dates, measured results and numbers, and any reported failure modes or limitations.
